decide_next_step_prompt_template.description: Main ReAct decide-step prompt - how the model chooses between tools (document search, memory recall, agent consultation, database resolution) or finish. Needs {instruction}, {scratchpad}, and {grounding_rule} placeholders.

compact_prompt_template.description: Folds one new tool observation into the running scratchpad. Needs {instruction}, {scratchpad}, {tool_name}, and {observation} placeholders.

final_answer_prompt_template.description: Forced final-answer prompt, used when the ReAct loop hits its step cap without calling finish. Needs {instruction}, {scratchpad}, and {grounding_rule} placeholders.

msg_no_matching_document.value: No matching document found in the knowledge base.
msg_no_matching_document.description: Shown when search_documents finds no document confident enough to match a query.

msg_document_not_found.description: Shown when read_document is called with a filename that isn't in the knowledge base.

msg_no_relevant_chunks.value: No relevant passages found in '{source_filename}' for that question.
msg_no_relevant_chunks.description: Shown when search_within_document finds nothing relevant enough inside an already-known document.

msg_kb_empty.value: The knowledge base is empty - no documents have been uploaded.
msg_kb_empty.description: Shown when list_documents is called but nothing has ever been uploaded to the knowledge base.

msg_no_contact.value: No specific person is associated with this request - nothing to recall.
msg_no_contact.description: Shown when recall_memory is called but no contact_name was ever attached to this conversation.

msg_nothing_in_memory.value: Nothing relevant found in conversation memory.
msg_nothing_in_memory.description: Shown when recall_memory finds a contact but no past conversation snippets relevant to the query.

msg_no_agents_discoverable.value: No other agents are currently discoverable.
msg_no_agents_discoverable.description: Shown when discover_agents finds no other agents registered in the mesh.

msg_agent_not_registered.value: No agent registered with id '{agent_id}' - call discover_agents first.
msg_agent_not_registered.description: Shown when consult_agent is called with an agent_id that isn't actually registered in the mesh.

msg_no_clear_answer.value: I wasn't able to find a clear answer.
msg_no_clear_answer.description: Fallback used if the ReAct loop's own final response has no text at all to fall back on.

msg_unknown_tool.description: Shown when the model calls a tool name that doesn't exist - should never happen in practice.

strict_grounding.description: If true, only tool-verified evidence counts as a basis for an answer - even an ordinary general-knowledge question gets an honest "nothing relevant found" instead of an answer from the model's own training data. If false, general knowledge is a legitimate fallback when no document/memory/agent had anything relevant, but a specific verifiable detail (a date, a price, a port number) still requires real tool-verified evidence.

observation_char_cap.description: Max characters kept from any single tool result before it's truncated - protects the ReAct loop's own prompt from being blown out by one huge document dump.

doc_search_top_k.description: How many passages search_within_document returns per query - more raises the odds the actually-relevant one is included, at the cost of a longer observation to read.
